notes: European banking-industry body governing the SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area) schemes. Publishes scheme rulebooks for SCT (SEPA Credit Transfer), SDD (SEPA Direct Debit), SCT Inst (instant credit transfer), and related cards-clearing schemes. Scheme rules include security and risk-management requirements for participating banks.
